script_core: One site that captures all service lines
pitch_headline: A SuperSite built to organize multiple service lines without feeling busy.
pitch_body: This version of the SuperSite is tuned for companies that handle more than one pool-related service. The goal is one clear front end that still feels clean, credible, and easy to act on.
section_title: A SuperSite that captures the full service picture.
section_copy: Multi-service companies need a site that clarifies the offer instead of scattering it. Reviews, structure, and contact flow should all work together.
video_section_title: One visual result can support multiple services.
video_section_body: A single transformation clip helps unify the site around outcome rather than a fragmented list of service categories.

why_cards.title: All services, one entry point
why_cards.body: The SuperSite should make it easy for homeowners to understand everything the company handles.

why_cards.title: Review proof across categories
why_cards.body: Strong feedback becomes more useful when the site pulls it into one clear experience.

why_cards.title: Cleaner service structure
why_cards.body: A better front end helps the company feel organized even when the actual service menu is broad.
